purpose: Reproducible next optimization experiment after a bottleneck is identified in the completed training profiles.
operating_condition: Use the same user-selected reduced-performance setting for every trial; record exact setting before and after, plus power source and temperature if available. Do not raise fan noise by changing system settings.

fixed_work.data: One frozen broad mixture; preloaded batches and identical nonpadding token counts
fixed_work.order: Predeclare randomized paired order with fixed seed 20260907

comparisons.condition: Implement only if completed profiles and padding statistics justify it; preserve source sequence sampling and record token exposure.
Change one factor; compare all model and optimizer arrays, gradients/loss and checkpoint resume before timing claims.

analysis: Report paired differences and variation, not only the fastest result. Identical settings do not eliminate thermal drift. Do not compare the two data mixtures as if they were a fixed-work code optimization benchmark.
monitoring: light for real runs; explicit off/light diagnostics only under the existing A/B authorization
activation: Requires the completed campaign profiles and a concrete candidate; no competing GPU experiment is started now.
